facts.fact: The Ministere de la Population et des Solidarites issued a call for expressions of interest, published 15 October 2026 and closing 29 October 2026, for a firm to design and build the information system (MIS RSU) of the Registre Social Unique under the World Bank-funded PFSR project.

systems.platform: national platform managing the RSU data lifecycle
systems.owner: Ministere de la Population et des Solidarites
